collections.name: FlowPros Mobile API
collections.description:
Every HTTP endpoint the **FlowPros mobile app** calls, read from its source.

### Quick start
1. Select an environment (**Testing** or **Production**) in the top bar.
2. Fill `username` and `password` in the environment.
3. Run **Auth & Session → Login**. Its extractors write `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into the environment.
4. Everything else inherits `access-token: {{accessToken}}` from this collection's auth.

### Conventions
- Auth is a custom header `access-token`, **not** `Authorization: Bearer`.
- Every response is `{ "status": true|false, … }`; `status: false` carries a `message`.
- `last_sync_time` / `date_from` / `date_to` are epoch **seconds**.
- Optional query params are listed but **disabled** — tick the ones you want.
- `v2` endpoints are the newer paginated/incremental ones.

Servers: Testing `https://testing-flowpros.odoo.com` · Production `https://o.flowpros.co`.

folders.name: Auth & Session
folders.description: Login, token refresh, app settings and the signed-in user's profile. **Run `Login` first** — its extractors store `accessToken` / `refreshToken` in the active environment.

folders.name: Jobs (tasks)
folders.description: Reading and changing jobs. In the backend a *job* is an Odoo `project.task`; `task_details_list` is the main sync endpoint, the others push local edits.

folders.name: Projects & Stages
folders.description: Project list, workflow stages and per-stage job counts used by the dashboard.

folders.name: Map
folders.description: Job coordinates for the map screen.

folders.name: Field configuration & master data
folders.description: Dynamic form definition (field groups) and the option lists behind relational fields.

folders.name: External (Google Routes)
folders.description: Not a FlowPros endpoint: the app calls Google directly to draw a route on the map. Needs `googleMapsApiKey` in the environment.

requests.name: Login
requests.description:
Exchanges username/password for an access + refresh token. `scope` is always `flow-pros`.

Response: `{ status, access_token, refresh_token, user_id }` (`user_id` may be an object with `id`, `user_type`, `name`).

The extractors below save the tokens into the **active environment**, so every other request authenticates automatically.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/auth/data/repositories/authentication_repository_impl.dart` → `AuthenticationRepositoryImpl.login`

requests.name: Refresh access token
requests.description:
Called by the app automatically after a `401`. Returns a fresh `access_token` (top-level, or under `data`).

Stores it back into `accessToken`.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/core/network/retry_policy/expired_token_retry_policy.dart` → `ExpiredTokenRetryPolicy._fetchNewAccessToken`

requests.name: Get app settings
requests.description:
Server-side app settings. The app reads the Firebase notification topic from `data.topic` (or `data.notification_topic` / `data.firebase_topic`).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/auth/data/repositories/authentication_repository_impl.dart` → `AuthenticationRepositoryImpl.getNotificationTopic`

requests.name: Get user profile
requests.description:
Signed-in user. Response `data` holds `id`, `name`, `job_title`, `email`, `user_type` (`user_type` decides technician vs project-manager screens).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/profile/data/repositories/profile_repository_impl.dart` → `ProfileRepositoryImpl.syncProfile`

requests.name: List jobs (paginated)
requests.description:
The job list screen. Optional filters are present but **disabled** — tick a row to use it.

- `query` free-text search · `stage_id` / `project_id` filter · `sort_by` + `order` (`asc`|`desc`)
- Any field's *technical name* can be used as a filter key, e.g. `bista_fixed_account_number`, `bista_fixed_location_address`, `tech_employee_id`.

Response: `{ status, data: [ job… ] }`. Each job has `fixed_fields`, `dynamic_fields` and an `is_revoked` flag (revoked jobs must be deleted from a local cache).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/job_repository_impl.dart` → `JobRepositoryImpl.syncJobsPaginated`

requests.name: Jobs — incremental sync
requests.description:
Delta sync: only jobs changed after `last_sync_time` (epoch **seconds**). Use `{{lastSyncTime}}` = `0` for a full download.

Response: `{ status, data: [ job… ] }`. Each job has `fixed_fields`, `dynamic_fields` and an `is_revoked` flag (revoked jobs must be deleted from a local cache).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.fetchJobsPage`

requests.name: Get one job by id
requests.description:
Fetches a single job through `job_id` (used after a push notification says a job changed).

Response: `{ status, data: [ job… ] }`. Each job has `fixed_fields`, `dynamic_fields` and an `is_revoked` flag (revoked jobs must be deleted from a local cache).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.fetchJobsPage(entityId)`

requests.name: Jobs by date range
requests.description:
`date_from` / `date_to` are epoch **seconds** (the app's defaults are `0` and `9999999999`).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/job_repository_impl.dart` → `JobRepositoryImpl.syncJobs`

requests.name: Create job
requests.description:
Creates a job. Success is `status: true` (or `result.success: true`).

> ⚠️ The mobile app defines this call but **no screen sends it yet**, so the payload keys are not fixed in the client code. The body below is a *sample* built from the field technical names the app uses elsewhere — adjust it to your server contract.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.createJob`

requests.name: Update job details
requests.description:
Pushes a submitted job. `task_id` plus any field technical names to change. The submit flow sends `status: "complete"` and the captured coordinates; the other keys are the form's fields.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.updateJob`

requests.name: Save task updates (draft)
requests.description:
Saves a draft. Besides success, `data.field_updates` and `data.group_updates` tell the app which fields became required/read-only/visible after the change (conditional form logic).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/job_action_repository_impl.dart` → `JobActionRepositoryImpl.save`

requests.name: Delete job
requests.description:
Deletes (or soft-deletes) a job. **Destructive** — double-check `{{jobId}}` and the active environment.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.deleteJob`

requests.name: Bulk update — selected jobs
requests.description:
Applies the same field values to several jobs. With `is_select_all: false` the `job_ids` list is used; every other top-level key is a field technical name to set.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.bulkUpdate`

requests.name: Bulk update — select all (filter)
requests.description:
`is_select_all: true` ignores `job_ids` and applies to everything matching `filter` (the list filter that was active in the app). The exact keys of `filter` are decided by the screen; `project_id` below is an example.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.bulkUpdate(isSelectAll)`

requests.name: Upload image / signature
requests.description:
`multipart/form-data` with the text parts below **plus a file part `image_file`** (the photo/signature).

> PostPilot's form-data editor handles text parts only, so attach `image_file` with cURL instead:
> `curl -X POST "{{baseUrl}}/api/v1/upload_image" -H "access-token: <token>" -F job_id=<id> -F field_name=<technical_name> -F file_name=photo.jpg -F image_file=@photo.jpg`

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/datasources/job_api_client.dart` → `JobApiClient.uploadImage`

requests.name: Project details
requests.description:
Projects the user can see. Response also carries `revoked_ids` (projects to delete from the local cache).

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/project_repository_impl.dart` → `ProjectRepositoryImpl.syncProjects`

requests.name: Task stage details
requests.description:
Workflow stages (Odoo `project.task.type`) with colour/icon. Entries with `is_revoked` must be dropped.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/pm_dashboard_repository_impl.dart` → `PmDashboardRepositoryImpl.getStageDetails`

requests.name: Stage-wise job count
requests.description:
Dashboard counters per stage. Send **either** `project_id` **or** `last_sync_time`. `204 No Content` means "nothing to count" and is a normal answer.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/pm_dashboard_repository_impl.dart` → `PmDashboardRepositoryImpl.syncStageWiseJobCountV2`

requests.name: Job map list
requests.description:
Lightweight list (`job id`, latitude, longitude, `stage_id`, address) for the map. `204` = no jobs. All filters are optional and disabled here.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/pm_dashboard_repository_impl.dart` → `PmDashboardRepositoryImpl.getMapLocations`

requests.name: Field group list
requests.description:
Defines the dynamic form: groups and whether each is required / read-only / visible. Send `job_id` (per-job attributes) **or** `project_id` **or** `last_sync_time`.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/pull/job_field_group_pull_sync_repository_impl.dart` → `JobFieldGroupPullSyncRepositoryImpl`

requests.name: Relational field master data (bulk)
requests.description:
Offline option lists for relational (dropdown) fields, paged. `field_model` narrows to one Odoo model; `last_sync_timestamp` (epoch seconds) makes it incremental.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/model_pull_sync_repository_impl.dart` → `ModelPullSyncRepositoryImpl.sync`

requests.name: Model data (targeted)
requests.description:
Options of **one** Odoo model, optionally scoped to a project (e.g. `project.task.type` for stages). The model names come from the field definitions, so use the value a field's `field_model` gives you.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/model_pull_sync_repository_impl.dart` → `ModelPullSyncRepositoryImpl.syncModel`

requests.name: Compute route (Google Routes API)
requests.description:
Draws the driving route technician → job. Google, not FlowPros: authenticated by `X-Goog-Api-Key`, not `access-token`. The mobile app also sends `X-Android-Package` / `X-Android-Cert` / `X-Ios-Bundle-Identifier` when the key is restricted to the app; with an unrestricted key those are not needed.

Response: `routes[0].polyline.encodedPolyline`.

**Source:** `FlowPros-MobileApp/lib/features/job/data/repositories/directions_repository_impl.dart` → `DirectionsRepositoryImpl.getDirections`
